name: projectKleee02
description: Play Kleee02 NFTs on an ILDA laser projector (bundled binary)

scripts.build:win: mkdir -p dist && npx pkg --targets node16-win-x64   --output dist/kleee02-win-x64.exe .
scripts.build:linux: mkdir -p dist && npx pkg --targets node16-linux-x64 --output dist/kleee02-linux-x64 .
scripts.build:mac: mkdir -p dist && npx pkg --targets node16-macos-x64 --output dist/kleee02-macos-x64 .
scripts.build:all: npm run build:win && npm run build:linux && npm run build:mac
